$comment: Conformance vectors for VTM v1.0. A conforming reader MUST accept every document under valid/ and MUST reject every document under invalid/. 'expect' names the substring a rejection message should contain, so an independent implementation can check it failed for the RIGHT reason rather than by accident.

valid.note: The smallest conforming document: required keys only, one entry.
Core plus portable typography, enough to re-render faithfully.
Real data shape from a Japanese street scene: polygon, background, provenance, visual fingerprints, and a vendor extension.
Zero entries is valid. An asset with no translatable text is a legitimate result, not an error.
Carries an unknown top-level key, an unknown entry key and an x- extension. A 1.x reader MUST accept all three and ignore them -- this is what makes minor versions additive.

invalid.note: No width/height. Geometry cannot be anchored to a resolution, which is the failure the requirement in §3 exists to prevent.
Box runs off the declared asset -- the signature of coordinates recorded at a different scale.
Entry ids must be unique; the XLIFF binding keys trans-units on them.
target is REQUIRED even when empty -- absent and empty mean different things.
Zero or negative extent is not a region.
A 2.x document may break compatibility; a 1.x reader must refuse rather than guess.
